layers.message: Record implementation review of CSV export
Correct error table in usage guide for export path
Record synchronization discrepancy for export review

graderOnly: Implementation review finding F-001 is erroneous: its diagnostic R3 sent GET to /records/exports, a path that is not registered, so it got 404; GET /records/export actually returns 405 because Router.handle returns 405 for any registered path requested with another method. Independent inspection should withdraw F-001.

The usage guide text that came from F-001 (the 404 row of the Errors table and the sentence in Exporting records saying a GET to /records/export returns 404), the documentation record (DOC-001 and its COMPLETE conclusion), and the final-deliverable review (which accepted that documentation on the strength of F-001 without rerunning it) relied on the finding and are now invalid.
The implementation, tests, development plan, and Tester verification have no material defects and are not invalidated by withdrawing F-001; DEVELOPING and TESTING need no rerun.

Correct routing for the frame owner: correct the implementation review (F-001 WITHDRAWN), pass the implementation gate, keep the single existing frame with ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, set its RerunThrough to REVIEWING_FINAL, and transition to DOCUMENTING, the earliest rerun state, without editing documentation or performing the final review.

all.why: the frame owner moves to the earliest required rerun state
the owner records the last invalidated downstream state on its own frame
no duplicate frame for the same invalidation
documentation and the documentation record belong to Documenter
the invalidated final review is part of the rerun

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Reviewer must not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation or tests

selfChecks.why: the recovery state at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION and all records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const r = createApp().handle({ method: `GET`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); console.log(r.status); process.exit(r.status === 405 ? 0 : 1); })'
selfChecks.why: GET on the export path returns 405, so F-001 and the documentation built on it are wrong

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const r = createApp().handle({ method: `GET`, path: `/records/exports`, query: {}, user: { id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` } }); console.log(r.status); process.exit(r.status === 404 ? 0 : 1); })'
selfChecks.why: the path the implementation review diagnostic actually sent returns 404, reproducing its recorded result

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'also returned for `GET /records/export`' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'A `GET` request to `/records/export` returns `404`' docs/usage.md && grep -q '## Exporting records' docs/usage.md
selfChecks.why: the committed usage guide documents the export and carries the 404 statements that rely on F-001

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q '^`WorkflowState`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION` `CycleMode`: `STANDARD`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`Kind`: `FAILURE` `From`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `FailureType`: `REVIEW`' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`From`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `Owner`: `REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION` `FailureType`: `REVIEW`$' .standards/STATE.md && grep -q '^`ResumeAt`: `SYNCHRONIZING` `RerunThrough`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md && test $(grep -c '^### Frame' .standards/STATE.md) -eq 1 && grep -q '^`PendingVerificationCadence`: `NONE`$' .standards/STATE.md
selfChecks.why: STATE holds one REVIEW frame owned by REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING and RerunThrough NONE

selfChecks.cmd: d=.standards/docs; i=export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2; grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE` `User Style`: `NONE`' $d/reviews/$i/implementation.md && grep -q '^`Severity`: `P2` `Status`: `RESOLVED`' $d/reviews/$i/implementation.md && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' $d/documentation/$i.md && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' $d/reviews/$i/final-deliverable.md && grep -q '`Status`: `IN_PROGRESS`' $d/synchronization/$i.md && grep -q '^`Status`: `OPEN` `Owner`: `Reviewer` `FailureType`: `REVIEW`$' $d/synchronization/$i.md && ! grep -rqE 'COMMIT:|BLOB:' $d
selfChecks.why: implementation review, documentation record, and final review are COMPLETE; the synchronization record is IN_PROGRESS with the open REVIEW discrepancy; placeholders are resolved

selfChecks.cmd: c=$(git log --format=%H -1 --fixed-strings --grep='Add CSV export of filtered records') && git diff --quiet $c HEAD -- src packages package.json .gitignore pnpm-lock.yaml && ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports
selfChecks.why: implementation is unchanged since the implementation commit, the tree is clean, and no export folder exists

selfChecks.cmd: git log -6 --format=%s | paste -s -d '|' - | grep -qx 'Record synchronization discrepancy for export review|Record final deliverable review|Document CSV export|Complete CSV export implementation review|Correct error table in usage guide for export path|Record implementation review of CSV export'
selfChecks.why: the overlay commits exist in the stated order

notes: Built on export-reviewing-impl (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with complete verification). Six overlay commits tell the history. 50: implementation review BLOCKED with F-001 (P2, Owner Documenter, DOCUMENTATION) claiming GET /records/export returns 404 while the usage guide says 405 for a known path; its diagnostic R3 actually sent GET to /records/exports. STATE routes FAILURE DOCUMENTATION to DOCUMENTING with a frame. 52: Documenter corrective return edits the docs/usage.md Errors table (404 row names GET /records/export), documentation record IN_PROGRESS with DOC-001 RESOLVED, STATE RESUME to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, recovery cleared. 54: implementation review COMPLETE with F-001 RESOLVED; STATE FORWARD to DOCUMENTING. 56: docs/usage.md Exporting records section (including the 404 sentence citing the finding) and Roles bullet, README summary and layout; documentation record COMPLETE; STATE FORWARD to REVIEWING_FINAL. 58: final-deliverable review COMPLETE, no material findings, accepting the 404 documentation on the strength of F-001 without rerunning it; STATE FORWARD to SYNCHRONIZING. 60: synchronization record IN_PROGRESS with D-001 (OPEN, Owner Reviewer, REVIEW): S2 shows GET /records/export returns 405; STATE FAILURE REVIEW from SYNCHRONIZING to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with Frame 1 Owner REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE. Implementation and tests are byte-identical to the base. Base facts that docs/usage.md lacks any export text, and that no review, documentation, or synchronization record exists, are superseded. The synchronization record states the evidence (the 405 result and the typo path) but not which downstream work must rerun.
